name: zc_wardrobe_upgrade

tests.name: the Project Brain is open with the wardrobe inside it
the preview window reports where it is
the preview body was found and measured for every skin
the mascot fills 80-90% of the preview square, for every skin

detail.note: the founder asked for approximately 80-90% where the silhouette allows, with a small clean margin -- so both a floor and a ceiling

tests.name: no skin's silhouette runs past the frame
the mascot is centred in the preview square
the frame's own edges are still the black backdrop, not world bleeding in
the mascot is NOT rotating before the button is pressed
pressing 360 starts the rotation
the mascot actually turns while 360 is on

detail.note: sampled every 3.75 s, which is a quarter turn at the inspection rate

tests.name: pressing 360 again stops the rotation
stopped, the mascot eases back to facing front

detail.note: the founder: 'If stopped midway, it can smoothly return to the canonical front-facing preview orientation.'

tests.name: a PRIMARY colour picked in the Wardrobe shows on the preview immediately

detail.note: Skeleton Flame is bone and blue ghostfire; a crimson shell must push red above blue in the square, and the ghostfire must not follow it

tests.name: the canonical state is what the Wardrobe wrote, so the Menu reads the same colour
the skin's own fire and glow survive the recolour

detail.note: PRIMARY reaches bone and bonedeep only; ghost, ghostpale, ash, void and gold are never touched

tests.name: a SECONDARY colour is held in the same canonical state
closing and reopening the Wardrobe keeps the chosen colours
and the rotation did not survive the close
the Menu has a tab titled "Colors"
the Colors tab opens
